messages:
ana-sales: Heads-up  Prospect Meridian wants a 2-week POC; procurement needs SOC 2 summary, ISO cert, signed pen-test attestation, and confirmation of EU data residency before spinning up staging. Can we deliver this week?

tyler-se: I can export the SOC2 summary + control matrix excerpt we share for POCs. Need redaction guidance (user/org identifiers).

priya-security: We can provide SOC2 Type II summary and a redacted control matrix. Full report requires NDA + secure transfer. ISO cert PDF ok to share.

mike-ps: Procurement asked for a pen-test attestation letter with a named signatory. Do we have a standard template?

priya-security: Yes: we issue a signed attestation: "Redwood Inference confirms a third-party penetration test was completed on YYYY-MM and there were no critical open findings at that time." We do not disclose raw findings without contract/legal terms.

artifact-bot: action: create presigned S3 link (7d) for artifacts  created by devex  link DM'd to ana-sales (hidden).

ana-sales: They also want eu-west-1 residency for the POC. For short trials we can host in eu-west-1 on Hosted with network isolation; pricing delta applies.

tyler-se: Estimate: ~1.5-1.8x baseline for a two-week dedicated slice in eu-west. I'll send formal delta tomorrow. KMS separation for true customer-managed keys needs Dedicated/Private and ~72h lead time.

priya-security: For audit access: we can deliver a read-only evidence bundle and run a 90-120min walkthrough with our security engineer. Live auditor SSO requires signed access terms + 5 business days to provision.

ana-sales: Next steps: 1) priya  sign & upload pen-test attestation to presigned link TODAY; 2) devex  upload SOC2 summary + ISO cert TODAY; 3) tyler  formal eu-west pricing delta TOMORROW; 4) mike  propose audit walkthrough slot and coordinate.

priya-security: Will attach signed attestation and contact details to the link.

mike-ps: Blocked slot proposed Wed 09:00 UTC for walkthrough, will confirm with Meridian.

ana-sales: Thanks team  I'll tell Meridian we can provide attestation and certs today and update them on pricing tomorrow. :thumbsup:
